title: rbac v2: enforce KMS region pinning and add audit metadata for residency
author: Ava Patel
description: Summary: Enforce KMS region pinning at RBAC v2 policy evaluation time and surface additional audit metadata to make residency decisions observable. Motivation: Customers in regulated industries require deterministic binding of KMS keys and data residency to regions; current RBAC v2 allowed ambiguous KMS selections in fallback paths which created a gap in compliance evidence. This PR closes that gap by validating region constraints at policy enforcement and by enriching audit logs with the KMS key region, resolved region, and policy decision rationale. Implementation: 1) Add a KMS region pinning module (auth/rbac_v2/kms_pinning.go) that resolves requested/key-backed region and performs policy checks before granting resource actions. 2) Extend RBAC decision object with flat audit metadata fields (audit.kms_key_id, audit.kms_key_region, audit.resolved_region, audit.policy_version, audit.decision_reason). 3) Emit structured audit events for both allowed and denied evaluations, persisted to the audit service and forwarded to customers in private deployments. 4) Add config schema changes to require explicit kms_region or kms_residency policy fields; include migration script to backfill existing policies that reference KMS keys without region tags. 5) Add unit and integration tests plus an e2e test harness for the redwood-private installer to validate on-prem KMS configs. Backwards compatibility: Default behavior remains permissive for policies that explicitly opt out via the new "kms_residency: none" flag; admins are required to opt-in per workspace to enforce region pinning. Checklist: [x] Design doc linked in ENG-2148, [x] Unit tests added, [x] Integration tests for dedicated/private flows, [x] Migration script for policy DB, [x] Docs updated (docs/rbac_v2.md), [x] Security scan pass. Rollout plan: Feature gated behind feature_flag.rbac_v2.kms_region_pinning; staged rollout starts with internal orgs and redwood-dedicated customers, monitor audit logs for drops in allowed actions, then enable for all orgs after two weeks of telemetry. Related: references SUP-889 for customer-reported mismatch and ENG-2148 for product request.
commit_summary: add kms region pinning module and resolver
extend decision object with audit metadata
add migration script to backfill kms_region
integration tests for private installer and dedicated flow
docs: update rbac_v2 and config schema
review_comments: Lucas Chen: Please ensure we don't add high-cardinality fields to the standard audit index - can we map kms_key_id to hashed_key_id for logs? Author reply: We hash kms_key_id before emitting to the public audit stream and keep unhashed in internal-only storage behind an ACL.

Priya Singh: The migration could change policy behavior for some customers. Suggest adding a dry-run mode and an admin notification step. Author reply: Added migrations flag --dry-run and a notification email to workspace admins; documented in migration_notes.

Diego Morales: Integration tests looked good but observed a 50ms tail latency increase in policy evaluation with resolver enabled. Author reply: Optimized cache for resolved keys (TTL 5m) and reduced tail latency to <10ms in our canary runs.
Security team (automated): security/scan flagged potential KMS client hardcoded credentials in tests. Author reply: Removed test credentials and switched to mocked credentials provider in tests.
QA: Found a flake in private installer due to Helm template path; fixed and re-ran e2e.
Ops: Recommend adding a monitoring dashboard for audit log throughput - added a per-tenant metric: audit.events.per_minute.
release_notes: Enforce KMS region pinning for RBAC v2 policies (opt-in via feature flag)
Audit logs now include kms_key_region and resolved_region for policy decisions
Migration script to backfill KMS region on existing policies
migration_notes: Run migrations/20260221_backfill_kms_region.sql in dry-run first to identify policies missing region metadata. Admins should review the generated report and either add kms_region tags to KMS keys in the key registry or opt the workspace out with kms_residency: none. After review, run without --dry-run; monitor audit logs during staged rollout. Ensure feature_flag.rbac_v2.kms_region_pinning is disabled until after migration to avoid unexpected denies.
tests: unit: auth/rbac_v2 package coverage added (~92% on new code)
integration: tests/rbac_kms_integration_test.go verifies KMS region resolution across dedicated/private
e2e: private installer test validates key registry interaction and audit forwarding
security_impact: low: no secret material is emitted to public audit stream (kms_key_id is hashed)
compliance: improves residency evidence for regulated customers
notes_for_ops: Feature is gated; enable via feature_flag.rbac_v2.kms_region_pinning per workspace. Monitor audit.events.per_minute and policy.denials.kms_region to catch misconfigured workspaces during rollout.
